high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a page from a document or book. The background is white with black text, and the text is formatted in a serif font. There are no people, objects, or setting depicted in the image; it is purely textual. The text discusses the concept of "embodiment" within the context of the enactive approach to cognition. It explains that embodiment recognizes the inseparability of cognition from the body and its sensorimotor capacities. The text elaborates on how movement and interaction with the world shape perception and understanding.
